title: One banana for luck? 20 monkeys! 🐒 | Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony | English Cartoon Comedy
description:
One banana for luck and the whole colony wakes up to twenty monkeys on its rooftops! Nobody expected a good-luck snack to turn into a full-scale bandar invasion, and the neighbourhood gang has to figure out who started this mess, who keeps feeding them, and why the monkeys seem to be in charge now. Lots of chaos, lots of laughs, and a sharp little lesson about how superstition can spread faster than gossip at the chai stall. Subscribe to Hullabaloo Cartoon Colony and join us for a brand new episode every week!
